title: BatteryAI Oxford V1 curve rows

sequence_id.description: Groups curve points into one forecast input.

modality.description: Oxford curve modality; C1ch is preferred when available.

point_index.description: Zero-based curve ordering within the sequence.

capacity_Ah.description: Capacity coordinate converted from Oxford mAh.

temperature_K.description: Cell temperature converted from Oxford Celsius.

actual_soh.description: Optional next-checkpoint SOH in percentage points.

x-ordering: point_index contiguous from zero; time_s nondecreasing
x-missing: Required measured fields cannot be missing. ICA and DVA are deterministically derived and invalid derivative intervals are masked. Current is unavailable and masked.
